title: Cashel Boyle O’Connor Fitzmaurice Tisdall Farrell
html_source: An insertion from nearly an hour earlier in the library in Lestrygonians. Bloom and his momentary companion, Mrs Josie Breen, find a bit of humor at Ferrell’s way of walking outside the lampposts, even when the sidewalks are not crowded.

 — Bad luck to the jewman that made them, Ben Dollard said. Thanks be to God he's not paid yet. 

 — And how is that basso profondo, Benjamin? Father Cowley asked.

, murmuring, glassyeyed, strode past the Kildare street club.

 Ben Dollard frowned and, making suddenly a chanter's mouth, gave forth a deep note. 

 — Aw! he said.
